tools.name: list_practitioner_tools
tools.description: List free source-backed practitioner tools. No account required.

tools.name: get_practitioner_tool
tools.description: Get current input choices, supported scope and official citations for a free practitioner tool.

tools.name: run_practitioner_tool
tools.description: Run a free source-backed practitioner tool with inputs from get_practitioner_tool. No account required; source uncertainty refuses an answer.

tools.name: get_subscriptions
tools.description: Read your connected free and paid subscriptions; requires account authorization.

tools.name: read_record
tools.description: Read current record details according to your existing subscription; no purchase or history included.

tools.name: list_registers
tools.description: Available obligation registers. Cite original source URLs.

tools.name: search_record_previews
tools.description: Free search across current and archived record previews. Returns purchase offers and coverage links; never spends money. Use a spending-limited local client to purchase.

tools.name: read_register
tools.description: Read the latest three records free. Scoped PRO access unlocks the archive and full fields.

tools.name: plan_uk_packaging_epr_registration
tools.description: Plan 2027 UK packaging EPR large-producer registration from reviewed current official guidance. Free; no account or subscription required. Self-attest producer classification; the answer is not an eligibility determination or total EPR cost.

tools.name: plan_minnesota_pfas_reporting
tools.description: Plan Minnesota PFAS initial product-reporting dates from reviewed current MPCA guidance. Free; no account or subscription required. Self-attest coverage and extension/waiver status; an individual waiver determination is not inferred.

tools.name: get_ndis_sda_options
tools.description: Get current source-validated SDA building, design and SA4 choices. Free; no account required.

tools.name: compare_ndis_sda
tools.description: Compare one or two post-2023 new-build SDA funding scenarios from current official facts. Free. Requires all residents to be SDA-eligible; excludes rent, support services, vacancies and individual eligibility decisions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_subscriptions" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read your connected free and paid subscriptions; requires account authorization.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_registers · Private data: read_record, search_record_previews, read_register · Public sink: compare_ndis_sda · Destructive: run_practitioner_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_registers · Private data: read_record, search_record_previews, read_register · Public sink: compare_ndis_sda · Destructive: run_practitioner_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
